notes.title: Back to School, Simple Nature 2 and Tiny Vehicles DLCs are now Live 🖌️
notes.notes: [h2]Hey there, coloring fans[/h2][hr][/hr][p]The end of summer vacation and returning to school or the office is never an easy time... but we have something that is sure to cheer you up! We are happy to announce that not one, not two, but three new sets of pictures have just arrived to Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number. Tens of new awesome coloring challenges await, inviting everyone to join in the fun with… 👇[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087854/632553dd34a06e7a51915a7b8153e82b72d74893.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Back to School, Simple Nature 2 and Tiny Vehicles DLCs[/h2][hr][/hr][p]Who could resist coloring lovely flowers or charming tiny vehicles? And that’s not even mentioning the Back to School pack… With today’s DLCs, you can enjoy a collection of fascinating, inspiring, and calming images, all ready to be colored by your hand! And although the summer vacations are ending, another exciting adventure is about to begin. Be sure to give new expansions a try and delve into their cozy vibe![/p][p][/p][h2]Get them now and continue your coloring journey[/h2][hr][/hr][p]Just a reminder, that on 25th of September we'll present you with Cute free pack, accompanied by Cute 2 and Landscapes 5. And now, without further ado, let's get to work with:[/p][p][/p][h3]Back to School Pack[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3941900/Pixel_Cross_Stitch__Back_To_School_Pack/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]Simple Nature 2 Pack[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3788560/Pixel_Cross_Stitch__Simple_Nature_Pack_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]Tiny Vehicles[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3307090/Pixel_Cross_Stitch__Tiny_Vehicles_Pack/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]Happy Coloring![/b][/h3]

notes.title: Vacations, Summer 3 and Simple Patterns 5 DLCs are here! 🌴
notes.notes: [h2]Hey there, coloring fans[/h2][hr][/hr][p]The sky is scorching hot and summer is in full swing! What better time to grab your favorite virtual coloring books and give new life to dozens of new images? The occasion for celebration is triple, because today we come to you with not one, not two, but three new DLCs, exactly as announced in our content Road Map. And so, it's time to welcome...[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087854/266cf8f33aa2dfba3abba11c7e0dad9bdaecf2b8.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Vacations, Summer 3, Simple Patterns 5 DLCs[/h2][hr][/hr][p]Beautiful sandy beaches, poolside chillout, tropical landscapes and relaxing sceneries are just to begin with. Join us on this summer adventure and color brand new engaging scenes. And if you need a bit of variety, you can dive right into the Simple Patterns 5 DLC where you'll find, well... tons of simple patterns! Are you ready for the next colorful adventure?[/p][p][/p][h2]What's coming next? [/h2][hr][/hr][p]On 4th of September we'll welcome the start of the school with Back to School free pack, accompanied by Simple Nature 2 and Tiny Vehicles.[/p][p]On 25th of September we'll present you with Cute free pack, accompanied by Cute 2 and Landscapes 5[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087854/9e973604b241a91be3d698cab4933229c3a4a549.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Happy Coloring![/b][/h3]

notes.title: Time for the New Roadmap!

notes.title: New Update is Live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087854/84fbcee2fed85a0d8a0b6578764a93673c37cf63.png[/img]

We’re thrilled to announce a fresh update for [i][b]Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number[/b][/i]!

[b]Here’s what’s new:[/b]
🎮 [b]Keyboard Mode:[/b] You can now enable keyboard mode in settings for a new way to play!
📜 [b]Key Bindings List:[/b] Check out the updated settings dialog for a full list of key bindings, plus some new options to enhance your gameplay.
🔄 [b]Customizable Controls:[/b] Added an option to invert RMB and MMB in standard mode, giving you more flexibility.
🎨 [b]Color Tile Automatization:[/b] Your first color is now set automatically at the start, and colors will auto-change after finishing the current one!
📊 [b]Color Tile Info:[/b] See the number of pixels left in a color directly on its tile for easier progress tracking.

💡 Don’t forget to leave us your feedback and reviews on Steam! Your thoughts inspire future updates.

[b]🎁 Exciting News![/b]
Don’t forget - this Thursday, we have a FREE DLC dropping for Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number! 🥳 Make sure to check it out and enhance your creative journey even more.

[b]🎄 Wishlist Alert![/b]
As the holiday season approaches, so does our next game, There's No Santa! 🎅 A perfect mix of festive vibes and fun - make sure to add it to your wishlist and get ready for some holiday cheer.

notes.title: Official Launch of Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45087854/9f1cbe5782ff3039664eb9ae76a070e69bcdccf6.png[/img]

Hey, Gamers!

[b]Pixel Cross Stitch Color by Number is now live![/b] This isn’t just a game, it’s a place to unwind, and with [b]10 DLC packs at launch[/b] full of extra art to color, you’ll have endless choices. Choose from over [b]100+ images[/b], including animals, landscapes, and more, and bring them to life with either Color-by-Number or Cross Stitch style.

[h2]What to expect?[/h2]
[list]
[*] 100+ pixel art images – from adorable animals to scenic landscapes
[*] 10 DLC packs – loaded with additional art for even more variety
[*] Two coloring styles – Color-by-Number or Cross Stitch
[*] Colorblind mode – accessible to everyone
